title: Grilled Fish Skewers with Mediterranean Relish
description: Delicious and easy-to-make skewers of marinated fish, served with a refreshing Mediterranean relish. Perfect for a light and healthy dinner.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, red pepper flakes, and salt.
3. Add the fish pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread the marinated fish onto the jagged skewers.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, combine the olives, artichoke hearts, and parsley in a small bowl.
7. Once the skewers are done, serve the fish hot with the Mediterranean relish spooned over the top.
8. Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
